text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Yukari has overdone it drinking once again,
so {0} carries her to the Mercurius Foundation guildhouse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
飲みすぎたユカリを抱えて、
{0}はギルドハウスに向かっていた。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh, sorry, {0}...
You're alwaysh havin' to shee me home... *hic*
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～
{0}くん、ごめんね～
お姉さんのこと、
送ってもらっちゃって～

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
But thassokay. Even if I do have a few too many,
I alwaysh got you to keep me shafe, like ya are now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
らいじょ～ぶらって～
飲み過ぎても、
こうやって、
キミが守ってくれるもん……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, {0}.
Y'know, I—
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねぇ、
{0}くん。
私ね……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What the...? Itsh so bright!
Has the sun gone out of whack?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はれ？　
まぶしっ！
太陽さんがおかしくなったのかな？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Aaahh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Eek! {0}?!
Oh... Um, hello.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ、{0}くん！？
あー……
ど、
どうもー

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Yukari quickly hides the big bag of cans she's holding
behind her back.
choice_data_list: Are you headed to a party or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言いながらゆかりは、手にもった大量の
缶を後ろ手に隠す。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh. Guess I wasn't quick enough, huh...
No, not a party. I just figured I'd drink
and watch some anime on my day off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あう。
やっぱり気づくよね……
お休みくらい、
飲みながらアニメ観ようかなーって……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I guess a girl who spends all day drinking
must be pretty cringey, huh?
choice_data_list: You are who you are, and that's cool with me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
昼間っから飲んでる女なんて……
ドン引きだよね？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Th-thank you.
You know, sometimes you say the nicest things out of nowhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぇ……
あ、
ありがと……
キミ、
たまにそういうこと、
さらっと言うよね……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, my boss is calling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あ、
会社の上司から電話だわ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What? The documents for the meeting tomorrow?
Oh yes, right. Those documents.
Don't worry, I've put them together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
明日の会議に使う資料？
あ、
あー、
資料。
資料ですね。
出来てます、
出来てます。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you want to look over them first thing in the morning?
So please have everything ready to go? U-understood!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
明日の朝一で目を通したいから。
準備しておいてくれ……？　
わ、
わかりましたー

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
O-oh no...
I forgot all about doing the report.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしよう。
資料作るの、
すっかり忘れてた……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to have to pull an all-nighter!
*sigh* But I'll never get it done at home...
There's too many temptations. I won't be able to focus!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
今夜中になんとかしないと……！
うう、でも家でなんて無理だよー！
誘惑が多いのに、
仕事に集中なんてできないよー！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Oh, what am I going to do? A-ha, that's it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、一体どうすれば……
そ、
そうだ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Let's go to your place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！
これから、
キミの家に行かせて！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, no, it's no good.
There's just no end to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うー、できないできない。
こんなのおわんないよぉ～！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, thank you...
Sorry about barging into your place like this.
I just wouldn't be able to get anything done at home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう、
ありがと……
ごめんね、家あがっちゃって。
自分の部屋だと、
絶対集中できないから……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... I was getting hungry, actually.
*chomp, chomp* These are tasty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと……お腹空いてたんだ。
……もぐもぐ……
おいひい。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Mm... That feels nice...
You know, you're a very kind guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んっ……
気持ちいい……
優しいね、
キミは。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...Okay!
I-I think I'm ready to get back at it!
Thanks, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし！
私、
もうちょっとだけ頑張る！
ありがとね、{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: And now we click \"send\", and... Whew, all done!
text_block_list.orig_text:
メール送信、
と……
ふわあ、
終わった～！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
{0}! Thank you so, so much for everything!
Now then, let's have a drink to celebrate!
Juice for you, of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！
手伝ってくれてありがとうね！
さあ、
お祝いの乾杯をしましょう！　
キミはジュースでね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few hours later.
text_block_list.orig_text: 数時間後──

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, y'know you really saved my shkin tonight...
You're really shomethin' for how young you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやあ、
きみは、ほんっろーに、
たよりになゆよね～
若いのに、
すごいろ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way, I'm not drunk!
I'm totally fine. *hic* Enough 'bout me, though...
Shay, {0}, you got a girlfriend?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
飲みすぎらないよー
でんでん、らいじょうぶ～
それよりも～
{0}くんは、
彼女とふぁ、
いゆの～？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
If ya don't, then what'sh your type?
C'mon, tell me! What kinda girl are ya into? *hic*
text_block_list.orig_text:
いないなら～、
好みのタイプは～？
ろんな子なのよ～
ねえねえ～

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Mebbe I should call it a night...?
...But m'not tired.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう寝たほうがいい……？
……寝ないもん。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Hey... What're your thoughtsh on older women?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ……
大人のおねえしゃんって……
ろう思う……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
{0}...
Ya ever thought about taking that next shtep into adulthood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……
大人のかいだん、
のぼりたくなひ……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ya may not know about it yet, {0}, but lemme tell ya...
that next shtep is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんの知らない、
大人のかいだん……
それはね……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...Sleep.
...Zzz, zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぱたん。
…………すぴー
すぴー

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.orig_text:
むにゃ……
{0}くん……
わたひ、
キミのことが……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} puts a blanket over the exhausted Yukari,
an amused smile on his face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
力尽きたゆかりを微笑ましく見ながら、
{0}はゆかりに布団をかけてあげるのだった……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And there we have it. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, you're going to forget about all of this
when you wake up. But, this time, you might feel
some lingering happiness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また例にもれず、
目が覚めれば夢のことはほとんど忘れちゃうわけだけど。
今回の内容なら、
幸福感くらいは残るかもね？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I have to say, even if you don't remember...
I'm surprised the two you could spend the night together
without anything steamy happening.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやでも、
忘れてしまうとしてもよ。
一つ屋根の下で夜を明かしたのに、
色気のないふたりだったわねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
But, I guess it doesn't matter...
The two of you will have your day soon enough.
I suppose that's all we can ask for, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、いいか……
いつかふたりが報われる日が来ますように。
そう願わないこともないかなぁ、
うん。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That's enough for today, though. Catch you later. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ今回はこの辺で。
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, huh? Is this the guildhouse?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
れ？　
ここ、
ギルドハウス……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}... Good morning.
Was all of that... a dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、{0}くん……
おはよう。
今のって……
夢？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What? We had the same dream again?
Wait, I can't really piece it together,
but wasn't I saying some pretty weird stuff?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
また、同じ夢を見てたの……？
待って、
よく覚えてないけど、
私夢の中で変なこと言ってなかった！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what gives?!
Why're you grinning like that, {0}?!
Please tell me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
ねえ！？
なんで嬉しそうなの{0}くん！？
私にも教えてよ～！
